notes.title: New Content: Gard'n Rush!
notes.content:
Hal!

That's a beautiful home garden you have there. It would be a shame if pests were to thieve your bounty from under your nose!

Luckily your have access to brand new FDA pending two-in-one Growth Hormone and Pest Popping Super Spray! Grow your carrots at accelerated speeds with only a negligible increase in crop combustion levels!

[previewyoutube=PFy0MPPd0Vs;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Gameplay Overview[/h2]
[h3]A Takelings take on red light green light.[/h3]

The Takelings will to sneak forward, traveling hidden under garden gnomes while Hal is tending his ammo garden. When he turns around, STOP and blend in to avoid his wrath.

Hal will trade between growing ballistic carrots, and launching them at any suspicious gnomes or free roaming Takelings. The launched carrot will propel itself forward, seeking out its target.

As a last ditch escape, or as a way to fall back to another gnome, Takelings can grab a daisy to fly back on the wind.

[h3]Other Updates[/h3]
Along with the release of the Gard'n Rush stage, this update includes a batch of new features, bugs, and quality of life changes. Here are some examples listed below.

-Added Ghost Takelings when respawning.
-Added play space calibration for Kitchen Chaos and automatically enables blink locomotion when play space is too small.
-Plates in the Kitchen are now breakable.
-Made it easier to enter the bread box in the Kitchen Chaos.
-Added electrocution effects to Hal's hand in Cellar Shock.
-Fixed animations not playing correctly in Garage Barrage.
-Fixed issue where grabbing objects while already making a closed fist would cause them to wobble wildly in Hal's hands.
-Fixed scaling of audio in options menu.

Good luck out there Hal!

notes.title: New Content: Garage Barage!
notes.content:
Hal!

It appears the Takelings have trapped you in the garage. Grab your nearest tennis racket and prepare to defend yourself. These pests will throw anything your way so remember: if you can dodge a wrench you can dodge a bowling ball!

[previewyoutube=cAJ2Ufz5t-4;full][/previewyoutube]

Make use of your trusty wooden racket to knock away projectiles. Takelings causing mischief just out of reach? Clock em' good with a well thrown racket and it will return to the hand using [b]Bungie Cord Technology, [/b] [i]oooo, it's the future![/i]. Beware, the racket can only take so much damage, so dodge the heavier items. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32814034/8a15107fd2fa48de35add20f21af1f40922a6f5a.gif[/img]

Takelings are drawn to these common garage items:
[list]
[*]Old damaged lawn mowers that you were intending to repair the next moment you have some free time.
[*]Coolers filled with bottles of your favorite unlabeled brown liquids.
[*]Corked bottles of non-descript toxic substances.
[*]Bowling balls teetering on high up shelves.
[*]Sparking wires tucked up behind your garage opener... for safety.
[/list]

Good luck out there Hal!

notes.title: Animations and Effects Update
notes.content:
This patch comes with a few animation updates as well as some fixes to physics jank in the kitchen level.

-Takelings now look directly at Hal (eye contact for maximum sympathy).
-Takelings now stand up on their own, rather than some instances where they would freeze upside down until the player provided a movement input.
-Teleporting rigidbodies back into the play zone now plays a smoke puff particle animation.

notes.title: Launch Bug Fixed
notes.content:
Fixed issue where launching the game would hang. 
Players would hear the music of the game and see a still image of the title. The game would either freeze here, never progressing or resume after a delay.

notes.title: Game Update 07/24/2020
notes.content:
[h1]Updates[/h1]

[h2]Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Improvements to grab detection on Takelings that can't be seen directly.
[*]Extra Lives no longer remove kills from kill counter or points from Hal.
[*]Added better feedback for when a scene change is triggered.
[*]Improved collision detection on fast moving Takelings. Should be harder to phase through walls now, especially when using the fire pepper speed boost.
[*]Improved hammer precision (Still needs more improvements).
[*]Only the hammer head can break the wall now, no more accidentally hitting the wall with the handle.
[*]Height calibration button moved out of settings menu and into the main pause screen for better visibility and access.
[/list]

[h2]Additions:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Physical button added to score screens to initiate new level.
[*]SafeZone for Takelings added to basement. No more Takelings disappearing out of bounds.
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed issue where pause menu sometimes would not work in attic.
[*]Fixed bug where sometimes Takelings would spin out when grabbed, and possibly clip through the floor.
[*]Fixed visual bug where pieces of the wall wouldn't properly disappear after breaking.
[*]Fixed bug where wrong controller icons would be assigned.
[*]Fixed bug where hands would go wobbly when grabbing objects with both the grip and trigger in the Kitchen.
[*]Fixed window in Kitchen being considered out of bounds causing Takelings and objects to teleport.
[*]Removed extra outlet next to waffle iron.
[/list]

notes.title: Game Update 05/30/2020
notes.content:
[h1]Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed issue where Quest Link users were stuck in the floor.
[*]Fixed issue where sometimes Takelings would get yeeted into the stratosphere disappearing from the game until the next round.
[*]Added back in the "Application has lost focus" warning so players are aware of when the Takelings window has lost focus and controller input will not be working until it's re-highlighted.
[/list]

notes.title: Game Update 05/20/2020
notes.content:
[h1]Updates[/h1]

Changes to address ambiguity with scoring!
[list]
[*]Takeling player score are now always displayed in their HUD player cards.
[*]Takelings now emit a coin particle when receiving points.
[*]Takelings now receive points for rescuing friends from being cooked!
[/list]

Other updates:
[list]
[*]Hal can no longer shove his head through geometry. Added a fade-in vision blocker when stepping out of bounds, no more clip peak cheating in the basement!
[*]Added controller type awareness to action prompts and player setup. Now instead of prompting "X" for every controller type, it will now correctly prompt the appropriate action button for that player.
[*]Takelings now receive actions prompts whenever near an interactable object.
[*]Added Takeling electrocution shader back into their electrical charge animation in the basement.
[*]Added flame on particles to the stove for a more dramatic effect.
[*]Takelings now teleport to the last grounded position in the kitchen rather than a random position when falling onto the floor. Similar behavior now to the Attic.
[/list]

Bug fixes:
[list]
[*]Fixed apples not highlighting when a Takeling hides in them.
[*]Fixed bubble gum balloons remaining in world if the piloting Takeling dies before it pops.
[/list]

notes.title: Game Update 03/22/2020
notes.content:
[h1]Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*]Kitchen physics colliders adjusted so there's less clipping through the counters and standing on geometry outside the bounds of the play space.
[*]Locked in Takelings in the toaster and sink can no longer be accidentally grabbed by the VR player preventing them from dying.
[*]Added a gesture control to the Toaster, now you can slap down on the lever without needing to grab it to start the cooking process.
[*]Added minor improvements to feedback while navigating menus.
[*]Fixed a shader bug that caused the nail guns in the attic to be invisible.
[/list]

notes.title: Game Update 03/05/2020
notes.content:
[h1]New Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*]New art for the plugs in the kitchen.
[*]The cables have a limited stretch range, players can no longer stretch cables all the way across the room.
[*]Added a power strip to replace the electrical outlet by the waffle iron to allow Takelings two points to attack from and nerf the waffle iron a bit.
[*]Added a new mechanic to the attic, now when Takelings fall on the floor, they return to their last standing position in the play space rather than teleporting to a random spot.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where Takelings would infinitely teleport in midair int he attic.
[*]Fixed a bug where the stove in the kitchen would suddenly stop burning things when lit.
[*]Fixed a bug where the hammer in the basement would get lodged in the wall so hard that Hal couldn't pull it back out.
[/list]

That's it for this most recent update! Next I'm going to be addressing some general quality of life things as well as address some of the clipping issues appearing in the kitchen.

Thanks all, happy pest hunting!

notes.title: Weekly Update: Basement
notes.content:
I think it's fair to say the Basement level had been the weakest minigame on our list. When Hal hit an electrical component, it felt unfair and frustrating. The Takeling players felt like there wasn't much to do proactively, resolving to wait for Hal to make his three mistakes.

I've attempted to address these issues in a few ways.
[olist]
[*]Hal now has 5 Lives (Fuses to break) to lengthen the game and to allow for more mistakes
[*]Hitting an Electrical Component triggers pain animations for the VR Player
[*]Hal's Studfinder will temporarily highlight objects it detects, removing ambiguity of where the Electrical Components are, and increasing precision when hunting Takelings
[*]Higher precision with the Hammer, now it's much harder to accidentally hit an Electrical Component
[*]The Electricity Charges in the walls, allowing Takelings to break the Electrical Components spawn at a much higher rate now
[*]The default settings for Party Mode are now, 3 lives each Takelings, and 0 shared lives reflecting the fact that teamwork doesn't play a big part in this mode
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32814034/51a3b5107cf1eb57293e6183f36ac322eda8f912.gif[/img]

The resulting game mode feels much higher paced and more empowering for both the Takelings and Hal. When you accidentally hit and Electrical Component as Hal now, you feel like it was deserved. The Takelings have a more proactive part to play with the increased spawn rate of the Electric Charge and Hal having more Fuses to break. 

Give it a go, let us know what you think on our Forum or Discord channel, happy pest hunting!
